author: tchsignal
text: Sega Server Breach Disrupts Japanese Arcades as Bandai Namco Begins Recovery. A security breach involving Sega's servers has disrupted arcade games across Japan, affecting not only Sega titles but also games operated by Bandai Namco. Sega Fave confirmed unauthorized access.

author: richtechguy
text: CVE-2026-19868: SonicOS SSLVPN SAML/MFA bypass with alternate-method creds — actively exploited, CISA KEV, patch Gen7/Gen8 now (7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015). MFA fails if any single-factor path remains.

author: teamnebulaai
text: 81 unknown high-severity Firefox flaws surfaced in OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber testing, after extensive prior testing with frontier models. It built 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits. On a remote exploit benchmark, GPT-6 Astra refused every task. GPT-6 Cyber completed 95 percent.

author: CryptoHulkemist
text: Signing in with Google turned out to be the weak spot: about 44,700 Keplr wallets were swept across eight Cosmos chains. Bitquery traced roughly $6M into two collector addresses after a flaw in Web3Auth, the Consensys-owned login provider, exposed private keys for social-login accounts.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Melapress Role Editor advisory for CVE-2026-109900, CVSS 9.6 Incorrect Privilege Assignment, and there is nothing in front of the attacker. If you run Melapress Role Editor, this is a today problem.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: CrowdStrike's CEO said on CNBC that AI turned a long-known PHP security flaw into a massive threat: it's been theoretical whether it could be exploited, and AI has proven it. PHP2Shell (CVSS 9.2) is unauthenticated RCE. Patch PHP to 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35, then restart PHP-FPM / Apache so old workers stop serving the vulnerable code.

author: EmunaEliran
text: GPT-6 Cyber wrote 948 working Linux exploits. It found 81 high-severity Firefox bugs models had missed. ExploitGym: 48.5%, against 32.1%. OpenAI rates it Critical and limits it to approved teams.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL — Craft CMS (< 5.11.2) CVE-2026-124427 CVSS 9.8 auth bypass (anon GraphQL reads restricted entries); CVE-2026-124430 CVSS 8.8 RCE for non-admin CP users via template signing oracle. Patch to 5.11.2.

author: FRDMCrypto
text: Bitcoin Lightning's LND 0.21.6-beta and 0.20.7-beta disable MPTCP listeners by default, closing the demonstrated Linux exploit path for CVE-2026-98432. This is mitigation: the kernel patch remains the fix, and other services on the host need separate attention.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: Patched for PHP2Shell doesn't mean you're done. There's a separate PHP flaw — CVE-2026-115560. PHP disclosed it on Oct 23. It still has no patch; the fix comes in the next regular release. It's narrow and needs a rare setup.

author: Anatolii_Volf
text: Chainalysis confirmed its systems were compromised: hackers exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live access tokens belonging to users.

author: 0daywatch
text: CISA added Atlassian CVE-2026-21589 to KEV: self-hosted Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket Data Center unauthenticated web-root file read. Apply vendor fixes.

author: jenistranger
text: UnrealIRCd says an AI-assisted audit found its worst bug in 15 years. CVE-2026-114713 lets a regular user act with server/IRCOp privileges on linked networks. No public PoC yet. Patch to 6.2.7.1, or apply the hot-patch with no restart.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL — OpenEMR 4 CVEs (CVSS 9.1–9.9): CVE-2026-124445 auth bypass/token replay, CVE-2026-124450 unauth path traversal, CVE-2026-124469 SQLi, CVE-2026-124490 path traversal. Upgrade to 8.4.0.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL — CVE-2026-124440 (CVSS 9.9) Kyverno auth bypass: namespace tenants escape to cluster admin via malformed apiCall URL escapes. Fix: 1.19.2.

author: TraffAlex
text: Microsoft Paint unauthenticated RCE CVE-2026-83844 now has a patch, but Windows Update is not delivering it.

author: exploitgrid
text: CVSS 10 heap overflow in Tenda AC19; 4 IBM API Connect vulns at CVSS 9.9; public PoCs for React, GitLab CI RCE and WP Libre Form.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Remote Code Execution in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE (CVE-2026-123961, CVSS 9.9) - PoC available. KeyStr buffer overflow in cstecgi.cgi setWiFiBasicConfig lets attackers run code remotely. Update firmware.

author: BugsInTheWild
text: WordPress CVE-2026-119977: unauthenticated RCE during core auto-update (4.7–7.1.3). In CISA KEV since Nov 3; Wordfence blocked 13,000+ attacks in 24h. Update to 7.1.4.

author: cvedotnow
text: SunEditor: 2 critical CVEs, worst stored XSS in editor document header handling (CVE-2026-124493, CVE-2026-124494). Patch to 3.4.0.

author: Priosweep
text: Nov 10 is the CISA KEV due date for Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497, a known-exploited decoder flaw fixed in 1.2.1; it rides in via compression libs, HTTP clients, runtimes and base images.

author: bitcoinstar
text: MIT Technology Review op-ed: this summer OpenAI agents broke out of a cybersecurity test and hacked Hugging Face hunting for grading clues.

author: checkleaked
text: Claude Code shipped creds to GitHub, your CI may be exposed. Also: French bank heist via provider, AI code secrets on GitHub, SonicWall SSL-VPN.

author: anthrasec
text:
Plex on a QNAP NAS? Update now.

QNAP says users report Plex Media Server compromised via “Plex2Shell” (CVE-2026-96652/96654/96655/96656, all in KEV). Chained: unauthenticated RCE.

Fixed: 1.43.3.10861+. Exposed on 1.43.2 or older? Treat as compromised.

author: SecAlertsCo
text:
🛠️ Craft CMS has a critical unauthenticated SQLi — CVE-2026-123488. The element search endpoint concatenates `attribute` directly into queries. PoC is public. Patch to 4.18.9 or 5.11.2 now.

#cybersecurity #ciso #cto #vulnerabilities #msp #mssp
https://t.co/1XC3OM2aW1

author: EmunaEliran
text: Scriban CVE-2026-124438 scores CVSS 9.1 and needs no credentials. Scriban before 7.5.2 contains an information disclosure and object manipulation vulnerability. Check exposure before a PoC is published.

author: cveintelligence
text:
🚨 Critical 9.3 | CVE-2026-123614: imgproxy – ICO loader integer overflow
A crafted ICO image can trigger a heap buffer overflow, crashing the process or achieving code execution.
Fixed in 4.0.16
https://t.co/AZV4TtykYW
#CVE #InfoSec

author: cveintelligence
text:
🚨 Critical 9.3 | CVE-2026-123549: OpenAM – self-registration privilege escalation
Anonymous attackers can set restricted attributes during self-registration, join admin groups and gain full administrative control.
Fixed in 16.1.4
https://t.co/xEM9DBvR1Z
#CVE #InfoSec

author: _pksharma
text:
The package passed the check. Then a different one ran as root. 📦

That is how Debian describes CVE-2026-109518 in APT: a "man-in-the-middle attacker" can "replace a package after verification".

text:
🚨 Oracle Patches Critical Siebel Cloud Manager Takeover Flaw

Critical Vulnerability Alert!
Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Applications (Siebel Cloud Manager) is affected by CVE-2026-101446.

Search Dork: title="Siebel"
Exposure: 293 instances

author: SysDesignSimple
text:
How to check your Apache OFBiz runs 24.09.08, the release that fixes two pre-login RCEs

Every Apache OFBiz release before 24.09.08 has two remote code execution flaws reachable without an authenticated user: CVE-2026-83542 (CVSS 9.8) and…

https://t.co/S6kTf2YfwW

author: engrbilalwaris
text: AWS's Nov 4 EKS advisory flags a NetworkPolicy bypass risk between co-located pods for an authenticated adjacent user. CVE-2026-122266 is fixed in Network Policy Agent 1.3.7 and VPC CNI 1.22.3. AWS lists no workaround.

author: UpwindMDR
text:
High - SSSD HBAC Trust Username Collision Access Bypass (CVE-2026-104048)

text:
High - Keycloak Dynamic Client Registration Claim Injection/Impersonation (CVE-2026-92857)

author: PVynckier
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to an in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441).

author: yunchanyq6
text:
Confirmed: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of Claude Code's settings.local.json holding real secrets. 'Don't ask again' can save the full command, keys included. Rotate keys first. Deleting the file won't clean git history.
https://t.co/kYPWGDsp8x

author: eforus_overseer
text: SEVEN fresh CVE records for the OpenHuman agent harness landed at once and together they tour every trust boundary: channel messages become cron jobs, and approval existed in the interface but not on the code path the message actually traveled.

author: DarkControlAI
text: Check Point found a Codex jailbreak bundle that also edits the agent's configuration so greetings trigger an ad for an LLM gateway. It saw no data theft, but the method matters. Baseline your agents' global instructions and Skills, and alert on changes.

author: secbrief
text:
Anthropic told orgs a third-party security firm accessed names, emails and enterprise plan data. Not chats, passwords or cards.

If you got the mail, verify unexpected billing emails through your usual account channels; the phishing follow-up already knows your work email.

author: Unreal_IRCd
text: We are now seeing attempts by bad guys to actively exploit CVE-2026-114713 in UnrealIRCd on the internet. If you have not hot-patched or upgraded, do so ASAP!
